description.p: Shows the active NetSuite SuiteCloud Development Framework (SDF) account from project.json directly in the WebStorm status bar.

ul.li: Auto-refreshes when the account changes in SuiteCloud settings
Click the label to search and select a configured SuiteCloud authentication ID
Search by authentication ID, account name, account number, role, or environment
Browse combined account-family/customer groups with aligned account, environment, and role columns
See related-account recommendations and confirm before switching to production
Open project.json directly from the account picker
Add an account through Oracle's NetSuite Account Management settings and refresh the picker on return

description.p: Requirement: The account picker uses an existing local SuiteCloud CLI for Java installation and invokes only its read-only manageauth -list operation. The status display remains available when the CLI is unavailable.
The Add an account action additionally requires Oracle's SuiteCloud IDE Plug-in for WebStorm, which handles authentication and credential storage.

The plugin does not read SuiteCloud credential contents, log CLI output, or provide automatic telemetry. Exception reports are sent to JetBrains Marketplace only when the user explicitly submits one from the IDE.

p.small: Independent project; not affiliated with or endorsed by Oracle.
